question.text: Ms. Anjali Kapoor, a resident individual LP, receives pass-through LTCG of INR 10 lakh from Neelkanth Listed Equity Alpha Fund (Cat II AIF, STT paid on both sides of the fund's trades). She has no other LTCG in FY25. Under Section 112A, what is her tax liability (basic rate, ignore surcharge/cess)?

answer.text: INR 1,09,375 (12.5% of INR 8.75 lakh after INR 1.25 lakh exemption)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pages 450 and 475), LTCG on STT-paid listed equity is exempt up to INR 1,25,000 per FY (raised from INR 1 lakh by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 w.e.f. 23 July 2024) and the excess is taxed under Section 112A at 12.5% without indexation. Taxable amount = 10,00,000 - 1,25,000 = 8,75,000; tax = 12.5% x 8,75,000 = INR 1,09,375. The Trap: Option B forgets the INR 1.25 lakh exemption. Option C applies the pre-23 July 2024 rate of 10%. Option D cites Section 10(38), which was withdrawn from 1 April 2018 and no longer exempts listed-equity LTCG. Note: The INR 1.25 lakh threshold, 12.5% rate and STT condition are stated in page 450; page 475 confirms the Section 10(38) withdrawal and the Section 112A computation framework.
